newsitem.title: USA: FINAL PRICING - Montgomery County, Md., Commission.
newsitem.headline: FINAL PRICING - Montgomery County, Md., Commission.

text.p: THE SERIES B BONDS ARE SUBJECT TO SPECIAL REDEMPTION, AT THE
PRINCIPAL AMOUNT THEREOF, PLUS ACCRUED INTEREST, IF ANY, IN
WHOLE OR IN PART, AT ANY TIME, AT THE OPTION OF THE
COMMISSION, FROM (1) AMOUNTS MADE AVAILABLE FROM THE ISSUANCE
OF THE SERIES B BONDS IN THE 1996 SERIES B MORTGAGE LOAN
ACCOUNT AND NOT INITIALLY USED TO FINANCE THE DEVELOPMENT
DESCRIBED HEREIN UNDER "THE PROGRAM-GENERAL" OR TO MAKE,
PURCHASE OR FINANCE OTHER MORTGAGE LOANS OR GUARANTEED
SECURITIES, (2) REVENUES WITH RESPECT TO ANY SERIES SERIES OF
BONDS, INCLUDING AMOUNTS RESULTING FROM RECOVERY PAYMENTS AND
PREPAYMENTS RELATING TO MORTGAGE LOANS OR GUARANTEED
SECURITIES FINANCED WITH THE PROCEEDS OF ANY SERIES OF BONDS
AND (3) AMOUNTS RESULTING FROM A REDUCTION IN THE RESERVE FUND
IN ADDITION, THE SERIES B BONDS ARE SUBJECT TO SPECIAL
REDEMPTION, AT THE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT THEREOF, PLUS ACCRUED
INTEREST, IF ANY IN WHOLE OR IN PART, AT ANY TIME, FROM THE
PROCEEDS OF THE SERIES B BONDS NOT USED TO REDEEM THE BONDS
BEING REFUNDED WITHIN 90 DAYS OF THE ISSUANCE OF THE SERIES B
The compliance addendum MSRB Rule G-11 will apply.
The award is expected Friday, November 15, 1996.
This issue is book entry through DTC.
